description: This script automates the download of kernel-related files such as System.map, vmlinux, and module information from a remote server for a specified architecture. It processes directories to extract build IDs and fetch corresponding kernel artifacts and manifests, facilitating kernel debugging and analysis workflows.

methods.name: download_kernel_info_files
methods.description: Downloads specific kernel info files from a remote server based on build ID, kernel target, and output folder.

methods.name: download_all_kernel_info_files
methods.description: Finds kernel directories matching a pattern and downloads all associated kernel info files based on stored build IDs.
